stories.story_fr: Philips obtient l'agrément FDA 510(k) pour deux solutions de cardiologie pilotées par l'IA : SmartHeart automatise 14 vues d'IRM cardiaque en un clic en moins de 30 secondes (jusqu'a 75% d'apnées en moins) et DeviceGuide guide en temps réel les procédures sur la plateforme Azurion.
stories.story_en: Philips secured FDA 510(k) clearance for two AI-powered cardiology solutions: SmartHeart automates 14 cardiac MR views in one click under 30 seconds (up to 75% fewer breath holds) and DeviceGuide adds real-time guidance on the Azurion platform.
stories.quote: SmartHeart automates 14 standard and advanced cardiac MR views in one click under 30 seconds, reducing breath holds by up to 75% ... DeviceGuide integrates seamlessly with the Azurion platform to enable real-time guidance during mitral valve procedures.

stories.story_fr: Philips signe une forte croissance comparable des prises de commandes de 6% au T1 2026 (contre 2% un an plus tôt), tirée par Diagnosis & Treatment et Connected Care et une performance soutenue en Amérique du Nord, gage de visibilité sur le revenu futur.
stories.story_en: Philips posted strong comparable order intake growth of 6% in Q1 2026 (versus 2% a year earlier), driven by Diagnosis & Treatment and Connected Care and sustained North America performance, a signal of future revenue visibility.
stories.quote: Comparable order intake growth 6% ... driven by growth in both Diagnosis & Treatment and Connected Care and continued strong performance in North America and International Region.

stories.story_fr: Philips reste le premier déposant de brevets MedTech a l'Office européen des brevets et le plus grand déposant néerlandais, reflet de son leadership en innovation plateforme intégrant matériel, logiciel et IA.
stories.story_en: Philips remains the number one MedTech patent applicant at the European Patent Office and the largest Dutch applicant, reflecting its leadership in platform innovation integrating hardware, software and AI.
stories.quote: Philips remains No. 1 in MedTech at the European Patent Office and the largest Dutch patent applicant, reflecting its leadership in health technology through AI-enabled, platform-based innovations.

stories.story_fr: Personal Health affiche une croissance comparable de 9% au T1 2026 avec une marge Adjusted EBITA portée a 15,8% (+60 points de base), le segment le plus rentable de Philips, soutenu par les lancements Sonicare et OneBlade.
stories.story_en: Personal Health delivered 9% comparable sales growth in Q1 2026 with Adjusted EBITA margin lifted to 15.8% (+60 basis points), Philips' most profitable segment, supported by Sonicare and OneBlade launches.
stories.quote: Personal Health comparable sales increased 9%. Adjusted EBITA margin increased 60 basis points to 15.8%, driven by higher sales and productivity.

stories.story_fr: Philips déploie son modèle de monitoring as a service avec des partenariats pluriannuels (University Health San Antonio, WellSpan Health, AdventHealth), basculant vers des revenus récurrents de services d'imagerie et de surveillance a l'échelle hospitalière.
stories.story_en: Philips is rolling out its monitoring-as-a-service model with multi-year partnerships (University Health San Antonio, WellSpan Health, AdventHealth), shifting toward recurring imaging and monitoring service revenue at hospital scale.
stories.quote: Philips signed a five-year Enterprise Monitoring as a Service partnership with University Health San Antonio to enable system-wide patient monitoring ... centralized surveillance and advanced analytics.

stories.story_fr: La marge de Connected Care recule de 60 points de base a 2,9% au T1 2026, pénalisée par l'impact de droits de douane plus élevés et l'inflation des coûts, principal vent contraire du portefeuille.
stories.story_en: Connected Care margin declined 60 basis points to 2.9% in Q1 2026, hurt by the impact of higher tariffs and cost inflation, the portfolio's main headwind.
stories.quote: Connected Care comparable sales increased 3%. Adjusted EBITA margin declined 60 basis points to 2.9%, mainly due to the impact of higher tariffs and cost inflation.
